describe: The image shows frozen dark teal ice seen from above, like polished marbled stone. Many thin, sharp, bright blue-white cracks and scratch veins run diagonally across it, crisp and hair-thin. Between them are deep teal and dark green cloudy areas with a few pale green frosty patches. Keep every crack and vein sharp and in the same place; render them crisper and more detailed, never softened into blobs. Even lighting, moderate contrast, fully opaque.
